rows.text: board approves a fresh **rights issue of up to Rs 50 crore**, subject to a postal ballot closing 6 November; price and ratio are not yet set
**withdraws its rights-issue application and draft letter of offer** filed with the exchange, pending a review of the objects and use of proceeds; the size was never disclosed.
